name: PT BISI International Tbk
summary: PT BISI International Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells hybrid seeds, horticulture seeds, rice seeds, and agriculture products in Indonesia and internationally. The company operates through Corn, Vegetable and Fruit, Paddy, Pesticides and Fertilizers, and Others segments. It engages in corn, various horticulture, hybrid paddy, non-hybrid paddy, leaf vegetables horticulture, fruit horticulture, fruit vegetables horticulture, chili, and plant breeding farming; after harvest services; seed selection for breeding; wholesale trading of paddy and field crop, fruits, agricultural and forestry machinery and equipment, fertilizers and agrochemical products, and vegetables; resea…
